purpose: Questions / information / answers register: what must be addressed before any decision can reasonably be made, what we already have, what we do not have, and what would settle each open item. Answers are deliberately blank where the information does not exist — nothing is inferred.

rows.question: What would change our mind about each strategy? (two-sided falsification field)
rows.what_we_know: Every strategy is pre-registered with its definition frozen before results were seen. Gates G1-G10 define failure conditions.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: No strategy has produced graded results yet, so no falsification evidence exists.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Graded out-of-sample results against the frozen definition; gate pass/fail record.

rows.question: Is there an executable price for grading ROI/CLV?
rows.what_we_know: The NFL publishes no betting lines, odds or prices anywhere on nfl.com or operations.nfl.com (re-checked 2026-11-15).
rows.what_we_do_not_know: None — this is a structural absence, not a gap in our capture.
rows.what_would_settle_it: A licensed or official odds feed (price-data policy decision, Q07).
rows.source: nfl.com/standings, nfl.com/schedules, nfl.com/injuries, operations.nfl.com — none publish prices

rows.question: How often does Questionable become Out, and how do designations evolve through the week?
rows.what_we_know: One weekly injury-capture snapshot exists for Week 10 (read 2026-11-15).
rows.what_we_do_not_know: Wednesday→Friday→kickoff designation deltas; no timestamped multi-day capture exists.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Snapshots of the injury report Wed/Thu/Fri plus kickoff, retained with timestamps and hashes (immutable availability snapshots).

rows.question: Does an injury designation predict whether a player actually plays?
rows.what_we_know: Week 10 designations (Out / Questionable / Doubtful) are published.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: The join of multiple seasons of designations to official inactive lists with play rate and confidence intervals per designation.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Several seasons of official designations joined to official inactives; per-designation play rate with CI.
rows.source: nfl.com/injuries/ + official inactive lists (not archived here)

rows.question: When a starter is out, what is the depth of the replacement (2nd / 3rd / 4th string / none)?
rows.what_we_know: Official Out/Questionable designations for 21 players across 10 teams (Week 10).
rows.what_we_do_not_know: Replacement name and depth rank; the NFL publishes no depth chart and the injury report carries no depth rank.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Official depth charts or official snap counts as starter proxy; Game Book lineups post-game.
rows.source: nfl.com (depth-chart route 404; injury report has no depth rank)

rows.question: Do injury designations change game outcomes? (needs archived injury reports)
rows.what_we_know: No archived weekly injury reports for past seasons exist in this repo.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: Whether Out/Questionable designations correlate with results.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Archive of weekly injury reports for past seasons joined to game results.

rows.question: Is the price-data policy decided before any backtest is published?
rows.what_we_know: Policy: market open/close cells are blank because the NFL publishes no odds; ROI is not computed. Backtests are not published as trading evidence.
rows.answer: Decided: no backtest ROI is published; price-data absence is documented (MK-01).
rows.what_would_settle_it: Policy remains as stated until a licensed/official feed exists.

rows.question: Is the venue of every fixture transcribed from the official game centre?
rows.what_we_know: Week 10 and Week 11 venues from nfl.com schedules; Munich (NE@DET) and Mexico City (MIN@SF) flagged as international/neutral.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: Venue for games where the schedule page did not render one (left blank rather than guessed).
rows.what_would_settle_it: Official game-centre venue field for every fixture.

rows.question: Is every strategy pre-registered with definition frozen before results are seen?
rows.what_we_know: 7 strategies registered in strategies.json with frozen definitions; registration discipline stated. The git commit hash is the registration.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: None for registered strategies; any future strategy must follow the same rule.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Commit hash of the frozen definition, published per strategy.

rows.question: Are correlations computed only from officially sourced numbers, with n published?
rows.what_we_know: CR-01/CR-02/CR-03 computed from official standings and schedule with n; all other correlations blank by rule.
rows.answer: yes — official inputs only, n published with every value
rows.what_would_settle_it: Continue refusing non-official inputs; publish n with every value.

rows.question: Is there a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper?
rows.what_we_know: DG-1 with four auto-firing conditions (DG-1a…DG-1d), evaluated weekly.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: The pre-registered drawdown limit (DG-1c) is not yet set.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Pre-register the drawdown limit before any strategy goes live.

rows.question: Are rewards funded and governed before any points are paid?
rows.what_we_know: 0 reward points awarded; leaderboard awards nothing until a strategy clears all gates.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: Reward pool source, size, governance and payout terms.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Written reward terms and funding decision by the owner.

rows.question: Has the 32-team roster/IR sweep been run before trusting any team-level model?
rows.what_we_do_not_know: IR/reserve-list status for every team (e.g. a player absent from the weekly report because he is on IR, not healthy).
rows.what_would_settle_it: Official transactions/IR capture for all 32 clubs; 'not listed' must never mean 'available'.

rows.question: Is injury signal modeled as a surprise (change in designation), never as a level?
rows.what_we_know: Policy decision recorded: designations are timestamped series; the model must not use designation level as a feature.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: Implementation of the surprise-feature in the model pipeline.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Code change + test that the model ingests designation deltas only.

rows.question: Is every injury-hub read stored with its clock time and the delta published (never the level)?
rows.what_we_know: One capture exists (2026-11-15); no clock time or delta is stored.
rows.what_we_do_not_know: Daily Wed→kickoff captures with fetch timestamps.
rows.what_would_settle_it: Immutable daily snapshots with retained hashes.
